src/services/exchanges/exchangeSettle.ts.reason: C06: one canonical union seeded with scalar new Order plus distinct original extras and ancestors, before evidence or Payment/Shift; no duplicate venue rows. Scope is capped before any row lock, then reread; changed scope rolls back and retries under executeExchangeInTransaction's ORDER_LOCK_WAIT_BUDGET.
C06: reentrant snapshots of credit Payments already in the locked union, before Shift; writeRefundInTx receives those snapshots, so no late lock-set expansion.

src/services/exchanges/exchangeTx.ts#pre.reason: C09 dispatch is the first branch, before immediate-exchange locks or money. It enters the same C06 opener with new + original scope; no lock union is extended after Payment or Shift.

src/services/exchanges/exchange.service..reason: C06 task6: cancelExchange opens with ORDER_LOCK_WAIT_BUDGET, including calls from the sweep. Only an already CANCELLED/DELETED new Order uses this direct path: exchange advisory then canonical Order ancestry, evidence and release CAS under Order. The live path takes kitchen/topology then Order through cancelOrderInTransaction. No later original Order/Payment/Shift claims; CHARGED rolls back before a separate settle opener. PostgreSQL cancel/terminal barriers cover both winners.
